parameters.query:
SELECT
    m.id,
    m.lead_id,
    m.text,
    m.processing_status,
    m.created_at,
    h.id AS handoff_id,
    h.status AS handoff_status,
    h.telegram_message_id,
    h.client_confirmation_message_id
FROM messages AS m
LEFT JOIN handoffs AS h
    ON h.source_message_id = m.id
WHERE m.direction = 'incoming'
  AND m.processing_status = 'pending'
  AND m.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  AND (
    m.last_alerted_at IS NULL
    OR m.last_alerted_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  )
ORDER BY m.created_at;

UPDATE messages
SET last_alerted_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::bigint
  AND processing_status = 'pending'
RETURNING id, processing_status, last_alerted_at;

SELECT id, lead_id, manager_chat_id, status, created_at
FROM handoffs
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  AND (
    last_alerted_at IS NULL
    OR last_alerted_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
  )
ORDER BY created_at;

UPDATE handoffs
SET last_alerted_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::bigint
  AND status = 'pending'
RETURNING id, status, last_alerted_at;

UPDATE leads AS l
SET
    status = 'handed_off',
    last_question_field = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE l.status = 'collecting'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM handoffs AS h
    WHERE h.lead_id = l.id
      AND h.status = 'sent'
      AND h.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL
      AND h.sent_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  )
RETURNING l.id, l.status;
